# Attribute Set (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Attribute Set` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-attributeset) | `GET /ref/attributeset?ID={ID}&Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-attributeset) | `POST /ref/attributeset` |
| [PUT](#put-ref-attributeset) | `PUT /ref/attributeset` |
| [DELETE](#delete-ref-attributeset) | `DELETE /ref/attributeset?ID={ID}` |


Attribute Set CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Attribute Set
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `ID`  | Guid           |         | Yes* | Required for PUT and DELETE, Ignored for POST operations |
| `Name`  | String             | 50        | Yes     | Attribute Set name
| `Attribute#Name`  | String             | 50        | Yes* | Attribute Set attribute name. # - int(1-10). Attribute1Name is required for POST, PUT.        |
| `Attribute#Type`  | String         | 50        | Yes* | Attribute Set attribute type. # - int(1-10). Attribute1Type is required for POST, PUT. Available values are `Not used`, `Text`, `Checkbox`, `List`, `Date`, `Numeric`.            |
| `Attribute#Values`  | String          |         | Yes* | Attribute Set attribute values. Delimiter ",". # - int(1-10). Attribute1Values is required for POST, PUT.             |
| `Attributes`  | <a href="#AttributeSetLineModel"><b>[] Attribute Set Line Model</b></a>          |         |       | Array with attributes. Read-only. |

## Attribute Set

Path: `/ref/attributeset`

<a id="get-ref-attributeset"></a>
### GET /ref/attributeset?ID={ID}&Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return location with the specific ID
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return locations that start with the specific name
